olokīyanthi: [ava + loka + ya + ante] (kamma, kri) CL=7 They should be looked at.
olopiya: [ava + lupa + ṇya] (ti) CL=7 Should be spreaded.
oloṇī: [(ava + loṇa=) oloṇa + ī.]  CL=9 Vi,pi, dhān.] A versatile dish made from the taste of milk. (Vajira.) Special dish. (View of some teachers (keci) from Sāattha and Vimati.) (A kind of the taste of milk made of raw milk in Vinicchakaṭīkā (keci). A special dish (apare). pure vinegar.
olubbhapavattikāraṇa: [olubbhapavatti + kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of a supporting place.
olubbhati: [ava + lubi + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (He) supports. He props up.
olubbhaṭṭha: [olubbha + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of a supporter or the meaning of a dependent person/thing/place.
olubbhitvā: [ava + lubha + ya + tvā.] (kri, vi) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 235.] Having supported.
olubbhārammaṇa: [olubbha + ārammaṇa] (na) CL=7 The sense object that is a support thing.
olubsa: [ava + lubi + tvā.] (kri, vi) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 123, 328.] To support. To lean up.
[ava + lubi + ṇya] (ti) CL=7 A dependent place or thing or person. See below.
oluggavilugga: [olugga + vilugga] (ti) CL=7 Slipped down and destroyed. Crashing down and destroying in disorder.
oluggaviluggajiṇṇasālā: [oluggaviluggā + jiṇṇasālā] (thī) CL=7 (An old hut) that falls down and destroys in disorder.
olugva: [ava + luja + ta.] (ti) CL=7 [Nirutti, nhā. 490. Avarugṇa (saṃ)] Falls and destroys at the bottom. See below.
olujjati: [ava + luja + ya + ti.] ( kri) CL=7 [Avalujyate(saṃ)] Especially destroys.
olumbhaka: [ava + lubhi + ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 Can be supported.
olumbhitvā: [ava + lubhi + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having supported. See - Olubbha 1.
olumbitvā: [ava + lubi + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having supported. Having propped up.
olumpetvā: [ava + lupi + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having placed. Having put in.
olī: [olī(li)yamana + ka] (li)yamānaka (ti) CL=7 Fades from memory or thinks no more of.
olīna: [ava + lī + yu.] (ti) CL=7 [Avalīna (saṃ)] (1) Hesitates. Sluggish. Decrease. (B) Inactive. (2) Slide down. Leakages from the bottom.
olīnamana: [olīna + mana] (ti) CL=7 One who has a sluggish mind.
olīnamānasa: [olīna + mānasa] (ti) CL=7 One who has a sluggish mind. See - Anolīnamānasa (jā, ṭṭha, 7. 335).
olīnavega: [olīna + vega] (ti) CL=7 Sluggish. One who has a weak power.
olīnavilīna: [olīna + vilīna] (ti) CL=7 Dripping down from the bottom of both sides. (say.). Slides down from both sides and drips down from the bottom of both sides.
olīnavutti: [olīnā + vutti] (ti) CL=7 Happens by the power of arising sluggish. Sluggish in practice.
olīnavuttika: [olīnā + vutti + ka] (ti) CL=7 Having sluggish in practice. One who has a weak striving or one who is sluggish in practice.
olīyana: [ava + lī + ya + yu] (ti) CL=7 (1) Hanging down. The dhamma that causes to hang down or come down. (thina middha.) (2) Sluggishness. Laziness. (3) Sluggish. (4) A hiding place.
olīyanappa: [olīyana + padesa] (pa)desa (pu) CL=7 (A cave) that is a hiding place.
olīyanataṇhābhinivesa: [olīyanataṇhā + abhinivesa] (pu) CL=7 Taṇhā that is sluggish. (Diṭṭhi) that is wrong thinking. See - Olīyati-(1) (A).
olīyanti: [ava + lī + ya + anti] (kri) CL=7 They hesitate. They are sluggish. See - Olīyati (1) (A).
olīyanābhinivesa: [olīyana + abhinivesa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Contemplates the wrong way by the power of sluggishness. (2) Thinks in the wrong way by the power of the sluggishness of taṇhā.
olīyanākāra: [olīyana + ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The function of hanging down. See - Olīyana (1).
olīyasi: [ava + lī + ya + si] (kri) CL=7 You attach (to). See - Olīyati (3).
olīyati: [ava + lī + ya + ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) He hesitates. (A) He is sluggish. He hesitates. (B) He is slow and inadequate. (2) He hangs down. He clings down or suspends. (3) He attaches (on).
olīyeyya: [ava + lī + ya + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should be sluggish. See - Olīyati (1)(A).
olīyituṃ: [ava + lī + ya + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To be hesitant or sluggish.
olīyitvā: [ava + lī + ya + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having was hesitate or sluggish.
olīyāmi: [ava + lī + ya + mi] (kri) CL=7 I attach (to). See - Olīyati (3).
olaggeyyu: [ava + laga(lagga) + ṇe + eyyuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 They should hang on. They should tie to. See - Olaggeti 2.
olambamānakikaṇikajālā: [olambamāna + kiṃkaṇikajālā] (thī) CL=7 The garland of jingle bells that are hanging down.
olambetu: [ava + labi(lamba) + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To hang down. To hook up (on).
olambitu: [ava + labi(lamba) + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To hang down. To cling down or to suspend.
olambisu: [ava + labi(lamba) + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They hung down. They clung down. See - Olambati.
olikhissa: [ava + likha + ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 I will cut and shave (my hair). See - Olikhati (4).
olikhitu: [ava + likha + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To make a hair-knot.
olikhi: [ava + likha + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 (1) I shaved (my) hair. (2) I released hair-knot. See - Olikhati- (2) (3).
olokayi: [ava + loka + ṇaya + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 He concentrated and contemplated. See - Olokayati.
olokayisu: [ava + loka + ṇaya + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They concentrated and contemplated. See - Olokayati.
olokessa: [ava + loka + ṇe + ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 I will concentrate and contemplate. See - Oloketi (2).
olokesu: [ava + loka + ṇe + uuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They concentrated and contemplated. See - Oloketi (2).
olokeyyu: [ava + loka + ṇe + eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should concentrate and contemplate. See - Oloketi (2).
olokāpesu: [ava + loka + ṇāpe + uuṃ] (kā, kri) CL=7 (They) caused to see (something) (as an inferior or low status). See - Olokāpeti.
olokāpetu: [ava + loka + ṇāpe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cause to look (something) (as an inferior or low status).
olīyitu: [ava + lī + ya + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To be hesitant or sluggish.
